events.title: 🎉 The Demo is Live for Next Fest!

events.title: 🐶 DEMO IS LIVE!
events.summary: It’s out. Right now, free on Steam, for anyone who wants it. We’ve been staring at this date for a long time and we still can’t quite believe it’s here.This one took a while. Months of building things, breaking them, arguing about them, and rebuilding them again. And now it’s just there, on the store page, waiting for you.A huge thank you to everyone who played the closed playtests. events.title: 🤿Mini Games in Progress
events.summary: Hey, Doggos! 🐕 You already know the core loop: grab loot, shoot fish, pilot the sub, don't die. But we've been experimenting in the workshop - twisting those familiar mechanics (loot hauling, shooting, sub piloting, crew coordination) into fresh, bite-sized experiences that feel totally new. The result? Mini Games! Think of them as the deep-sea equivalent of a pit stop. They're short, chaotic, and designed to be a breather between the massive main levels. events.title: 🐶 DEMO DATE REVEAL!
events.summary: Almost half a year ago this was four dogs, one leaky sub and a lot of hope. Then you showed up for the playtests, broke everything we built, and told us exactly how. The demo is ready because of that. events.title: 🐕‍🦺 Pick Your Pup!
events.summary: Hey, Doggos! 🐕 Every great dive starts with a great crew, and every great crew starts with the right face staring back at you from the roster screen. From the calm and collected to the absolutely unhinged, there's a pup for every playstyle. Are you the stoic bulldog? The Shiba Inu who's just happy to be included? The chihuahua vibrating with pure rage?Drop your pick in the comments - which face is joining your crew? Tag yourself. We'll wait🐾

events.title: Closed Playtest Ended
events.summary: Ahoy, Doggos!Our closed playtest has come to an end today. Thank you for playing and for all your feedback, it's been incredibly helpful! We're already back at work, and here's what's on our plate:The hub and its progressionNew enemiesFish raidsA new jump animation in the hubAnd much moreWe can't wait to show you the new version!

events.title: 💥When Cute Fish Go Bad
events.summary: Hey, Doggos! 🐕 Salty Dogs has always been home to a colorful cast of mostly harmless but delightfully chaotic underwater weirdos from loot-stealing Kleptos and clingy Magnets to explosive Fugas and the infamous Wind Fish just trying to live their best lives. But, as you already know, Catcthulhu's presence is spreading. Its corrupting energy is seeping into the deep, twisting innocent fish into something darker. Something that actively wants your sub destroyed. This is just the beginning. We're a

events.title: 🪖Lock, Load & Dive
events.summary: Hey, Doggos! 🐕 Last time, we were introduced to our archenemy. And we heard the obvious question: "Okay, but how are we supposed to fight back with just a harpoon?" 🎣 Fair point. One harpoon against an evil god is a bold strategy. So we gave your pups an arsenal. events.title: New playtest starts NOW
events.summary: Hey everyone!We are ready to dive back into the deep. A new closed playtest has started, and this time we've touched almost every system in the game. What's new:🐛 Bug fixes Cleaned up a bunch of accumulated issues, so the game runs more stable and feels better to play. 🔫 Progression update Reworked progression for weapons and skins, jump in and try it out! 🛠️ Reworked submarine workshop The workshop got a new look. 🧿 Ominous Totems A new threat on the levels: totems summon aggressive fish, but y

events.title: 🌊Why We Dive
events.summary: Hey, Doggos! 🐕We promised you a lore post, and we don't break promises. So here it is - the backstory of Salty Dogs, packed into one chaotic video! We wanted to give your pups a clear purpose, something that makes every dive feel personal. So we gave them an archenemy. A reason to suit up and to keep diving even when the oxygen is low and the fish are exploding. Your pup isn't just a diver anymore. They're a warrior with a grudge🐾

events.title: 🦑Less cozy more badass
events.summary: Welcome back, Salty Dogs It’s been a minute since our last devs diary. We went quiet for a while, but that’s because we were busy doing something crazy: we kinda reinvented the vibe of the game.After analyzing your runs, we realized something: the abyss needed to feel deeper. So, we ran an experiment. We pushed the action, dialed up the grit, and completely shifted the tone of the game.Salty Dogs is evolving. events.title: 🦈 When the Ocean Fights Back (Harder)
events.summary: Hey, Salty Dogs Welcome back to Devs Diary! You asked for more reasons to check your oxygen gauge twice. Today we're unveiling the next wave of sea defenders - and trust us, they're not happy to see your sub. Cat lovers, feel free to take notes on proper boundary-setting. Dog lovers, sharpen those harpoons. Let's dive in! 🦷 Biter Fish Each bite does minimal damage, but together? They'll chew through your submarine like it's a squeaky toy. ⚔️ Swordfish It'll charge straight for your harpoon cable

events.title: 😣 Deep Sea Bullies
events.summary: Welcome back to Devs Diary, Salty Dogs Last time we introduced you to the quirky locals. Today? We’re talking about the ones who actively want you out of their territory. If you thought oxygen was your only problem, wait till you meet the abyssal security team. Grab your harpoons, keep your paws steady, and brace for chaos. 🐍 Moray Eel It doesn’t just sit on treasure, it guards it. Touch its stash, and it won’t just glare. It’ll grab the loot… and if you’re still holding it? It’ll grab you too.

events.title: 🌊 Who Lives Under the Sea?
events.summary: Welcome aboard Salty Dogs. events.title: 🤿 All Paws on Deck
events.summary: Welcome to Salty Dogs! A game where you and up to 3 of your friends will depart on a deep sea adventure in the search of treasures. Customize your salty dog, get on the trusty submarine and go explore what under the sea has to offer. Physics can become an unpredictable enemy underwater, so work as a team! Don’t forget about oxygen, and be careful – you may encounter unexpected surprises on your journey. Sounds interesting? Sign up for a closed playtest! Click “Request Access” button on our Steam
